SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, buyer_id AS buyerId, seller_id AS sellerId, goods_id AS goodsId, goods_name AS goodsName, goods_pic AS goodsPic, goods_price AS goodsPrice, address_id AS addressId, goods_num AS goodsNum, total_amount AS totalAmount, order_status AS orderStatus, pay_type AS payType, pay_time AS payTime, delivery_time AS deliveryTime, receive_time AS receiveTime, cancel_time AS cancelTime, remark, refund_status AS refundStatus, refund_amount AS refundAmount, refund_reason AS refundReason, refund_time AS refundTime, refund_remark AS refundRemark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM order_info WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
